questions.prompt: Which empire did Cortés bring down in 1521?
questions.fact: He had a few hundred men, and won largely by allying with tens of thousands of the empire's own resentful subjects.

questions.prompt: What is the term for a chemical reaction that releases heat?
questions.fact: Burning and rusting are both examples, differing mainly in how fast the heat comes out.

questions.prompt: Which sport is played at Flushing Meadows?
questions.fact: Aircraft noise from the nearby airport is loud enough that flight paths are sometimes altered during finals.

questions.prompt: Which film features a character named Clarice Starling?
questions.fact: It is one of only three films to win all five of the major Academy Awards.

questions.prompt: Which continent has the fewest countries?
questions.fact: Antarctica has none at all; seven countries maintain territorial claims that most others do not recognise.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel The God of Small Things?
questions.fact: She published no second novel for twenty years, spending the interval on political writing instead.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the Erlang programming language?
questions.fact: It was built for telephone exchanges, where systems must keep running while being upgraded.
